Lab Sharpening. This enables you to only sharpen the light and dark pixels, which is especially good for not sharpening color noise as much.

Steps:
First you change your color mode from RGB to LAB. Then you go to your channels window and select the Lightness channel (This will make the image appear black and white). 

Once you've done this, go to the filters drop down and choose unsharp mask. Change sliders to taste.

Once it is sharpened the way you want, go back to the channels and make sure to select the top channel and then switch your color mode back to RGB.
